column1: # Upstream symbols this bar depends on, checked against the installed Omarchy
# shell and Quickshell type information. One line per dependency:
#   area <TAB> file <TAB> F|E <TAB> pattern <TAB> what breaks without it
# F = fixed string, E = extended regex. $OMARCHY is $OMARCHY_PATH
# (/usr/share/omarchy), $QS is the Quickshell QML module directory.
# Only what the code actually uses is listed, so unrelated upstream changes
# One symbol per line: a regex alternation may spell one dependency two ways
# (e.g. composed|pick), never list several symbols, or the row would pass
# while one of them is gone.
# A trailing ? (F?, E?) marks a conditional dependency: only an opt-in feature
# uses it (the experimental Control Center, bar.islands.controlCenter). It
# still fails the check; check-contract.sh --advisory reports it as WARN.
